name: vllm-project_vllm/vllm/model_executor/models/transformers/AGENT.python.tools.md

vllm-project_vllm/vllm/model_executor/mo.create_transformers_base_model: create a vLLM model instance from a HuggingFace Transformers model using the Base backend class
vllm-project_vllm/vllm/model_executor/mo.load_model_weights: load pretrained weights into a transformers-based vLLM model using the AutoWeightsLoader with HF-to-vLLM name mapping
vllm-project_vllm/vllm/model_executor/mo.replace_model_layers: replace nn.Linear, nn.Conv2d, and RMSNorm layers in a transformers model with vLLM tensor-parallel equivalents
vllm-project_vllm/vllm/model_executor/mo.run_model_forward: run a forward pass on a transformers-based vLLM model with input_ids, positions, and attention instances
vllm-project_vllm/vllm/model_executor/mo.create_attention_instances: create vLLM Attention instances for KV cache allocation from a transformers model config

vllm-project_vllm/vllm/model_executor/mo.create_causal_mixin_model: create a vLLM causal language model using CausalMixin with VllmConfig and a HuggingFace transformers config
vllm-project_vllm/vllm/model_executor/mo.build_lm_head: build a ParallelLMHead layer for the causal model with vocab size, hidden size, and quantization config
